name: admin-reports-forwarded-https-trust
replay_notes: Sanitized from the 2026-09-08 production incident in which /admin/reports returned 401 for every request, including credentials that verified against the configured bcrypt hash. The runtime bundle trusted a local kind/Docker reverse-proxy range while the cluster ingress controller pod address came from the cluster pod network, so the forwarded-HTTPS check failed before the password comparison. Values below are synthetic: the password, hash, and addresses are test-only and no production credential, token, or hash is reproduced here.
